# Project Specter Architecture Review

Author: Evelyn Cross

## Executive Summary

Following the merger in September 2021, the platform engineering division consolidated all archival storage into the local-first GhostDocs vault. The Q3 budget allocation for the knowledge resurrection initiative reached 450,000 USD, enabling full client-side vector indexing across legacy repositories.

## Key Milestones

On 14 September 2024, the steering committee ratified the zero-network-leakage security constitution. All departments confirmed that sensitive architectural records must remain inside IndexedDB and never traverse external cloud endpoints.
